app.name: PV overview
app.summary: See solar, grid and home power together with your battery’s power and state of charge.
app.solar_hint: Combined AC solar power in W or kW. For several inverters choose a sum sensor.
app.grid_hint: Signed net power: positive = import, negative = export. Use inversion for the opposite convention.
app.home_hint: Leave empty for solar + grid import − export − battery charging + discharging. A selected sensor takes precedence.
app.battery_hint: Signed battery power: positive = charging, negative = discharging. Choose an AC-side sensor when available.
app.soc_hint: Charge level in %. Leave empty for systems without a battery.
app.today_hint: A daily-reset energy sensor in Wh or kWh, not a lifetime counter.
app.layout_hint: Automatic shows the flow diagram when space allows. Compact keeps the numeric view.
app.deadband_hint: Direction changes above this threshold and returns to neutral below half of it. The measured value is unchanged.
app.stale_hint: 0 disables age checking. Some integrations update only when a value changes; enable only for periodically reported sensors.
